description: Every route the TypeScript server answers. RPC routes are POST {basePath}/{path} with a JSON object body; `credential: "none"` routes ignore request credentials, others authenticate with a bearer token or the session cookie. Ports must answer exactly this set.

rules: path = pathname without "{basePath}/"; authorize, authorizeMany, listAccessible and plugins/* first
otherwise exactly two segments group/method; more or fewer is NOT_FOUND
auth methods: publicAuthMethods are called with the body, authenticatedAuthMethods with (credential, body); others NOT_FOUND
other groups must be in routeGroups and have an own method of that name; publicApiMethods are called with the body, others with (credential, body)
auth/beginMfa: { tenantId, challenge } when body.challenge is a string, else the request credential

auth/confirmMfa: credential = body.credential { tenantId, challenge } when its challenge is a string, else the request credential; code = text(body.code); rememberDevice = body.rememberDevice === true
dispatch.spanName: the route path when the route table knows it, otherwise (unknown)

request.bearerPrecedence: A request with an Authorization header on a non-public route never sets or clears the session cookie.

headers.access-control-allow-headers: content-type, x-better-iam, authorization, x-request-id, x-better-iam-persistent, x-better-iam-device

cors.trustedOrigins: config.trustedOrigins plus organization hosts (ctx.hosts.trustsOrigin); an untrusted Origin is refused with UNTRUSTED_ORIGIN 403 and no CORS headers

csrf.rule: content-type must start with application/json (case-insensitive) and X-Better-IAM must be 1
a request carrying a Cookie header must carry an Origin header

request.hostPinning: Public routes that are tenant-bound (every public auth method and tenantBoundPublicMethods) take the organization of the request's host: a missing tenantId is filled in, a different one fails with HOST_MISMATCH 403 ('This address belongs to another organization'); without a pinned host the named tenant must be served by this region (WRONG_REGION). auth/confirmMfa also pins body.credential.tenantId.

device.name: better-iam.device (prefixed __Host- when baseURL is https)
device.readBy: deviceTokenRoutes: injected as body.deviceToken when the body has none
device.setBy: any result with string deviceToken and number deviceExpiresAt

session.attributes: HttpOnly; Secure (https only); SameSite=Lax|Strict (http.cookieSameSite); Path=/; Max-Age=<seconds until session.expiresAt> when persistent
session.clearedBy: auth/signOut (Max-Age=0, also when the sign-out fails), unless the request used a bearer credential
session.name: better-iam.session (prefixed __Host- when baseURL is https)
session.persistence: X-Better-IAM-Persistent: 1 or 0 on the request decides; otherwise http.persistentCookies (default true)
session.setBy: sessionCookieRoutes (and protocol mounts answering JSON with token and session.expiresAt), unless the request used a bearer credential

headers.retry-after: ceil(retryAfterMs / 1000), when the error carries retryAfterMs > 0

response.sessionProjection: A top-level result.session loses tokenHash and uniqueKey before serialization.

special.spanName: plugins/{pluginId}/{path} for a registered POST endpoint, otherwise (unknown)
